query: SELECT DISTINCT target_service_id AS "service!: String",target_endpoint_id AS "endpoint!: String",target_session_id AS "session!: String" FROM router_pushes WHERE kind IN ('notification-listing','board-notification','subscription-activity','subscription-expiry') AND delivery_state IN ('pending','held','attempted') ORDER BY target_service_id,target_endpoint_id,target_session_id
